hotel_name: South Inn - Green Park South Delhi

positive_snippets: After seeing 3 properties in this street this was by far the best. I didn’t agree to stay in the other 2 places but this one looked better and I also run out of choices… As a tourist, I was more suspicious but it all turned out OK. Clean, polite, simple (but no so cheap, so that’s why 4 and not 5 stars. And also because I waited over 30 min for butter toast as breakfast and eventually checked out without eating anything)

I had a pleasant stay at Hotel South Inn. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and comfortable. The staff was courteous and quick to assist with any requests. The location was convenient, with easy access to nearby landmarks and restaurants. The breakfast was fresh and had a decent variety. Overall, a great choice for both business and leisure stays — definitely worth recommending!

Stayed in hotel on 24th September 2025. Hotel is very nice. It's location is very good. Sarojini Market is very near from location. All prime facilities are reachable from hotel location. It is a safe place for tourists. For visitors Green Park metro station is at walkable distance from hotel. Hotel staff is very helpful. They had served in a very nice manner. Rooms are so neat and clean. Inside atmosphere of hotel is mesmerising. Very good in serving hospitality. 👌👌👌
negative_snippets:
Pros

Good location, within walking distance of Green Park Metro Station

Safe place to stay

Good service by the staff

Tea and coffee pouches with sugar and milk powder are provided

Electric kettle available in the room

Small ceiling fan provided in the bathroom, useful during hot weather

Quiet and peaceful environment

Essential toiletries are available

Cons

No lift available to carry luggage to upper floors; however, staff can assist

Room rates are slightly higher compared to the room size

Very small room: one king-size bed with only about 2 feet of passage on both sides

No extra space to keep luggage or personal belongings; the table is mostly occupied by the electric kettle, glasses, and other items

Only one charging point, which is not conveniently located; however, an extension board is provided for charging electronic devices

Not much food options are available to nearby locations

If you are looking for stay in air bnb then it's a choice . Each time you have to walk 3 floor to go to your rooms. Don't get fooled by 4.83 ratings . If you are good with walking upto 3rd floor with luggage then that's the hotel for you since there is no lift .
Food is also not upto the mark .
On hotel website there is incomplete information.
Hotel rooms are so tiny that only a bed can be fitted  where as prices are high as 4 star hotel. Manager was unable to understand our concern ,since we paid a heavy amount we got to stay there .
Hygiene : 0
Same brush used for toilet  and same brush is used to clean all sink .
